Starting Balances — Fixed Assets

This screen allows you to set up your starting balances for fixed assets that you have created under the Fixed Assets tab. Setting starting balances is important when you are transitioning to Manager from another accounting system or starting with existing assets.

To create a new starting balance for a fixed asset, click the New Starting Balance button.

FixedAssetsNewStartingBalance

You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the fixed asset. See Starting Balance for Fixed Asset Form for more information on how to complete this form.
